title: 巴德·米普小野餐
description: 圆滚滚的巴德坐在草垫上摆放小铃铛，几只米普围在点心盘旁。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Bard is a round mysterious celestial traveler with a large pale mask showing three simple dark apertures, a fluffy white mane and beard, short limbs, and warm red-brown robes. Preserve his curved golden horn-like head ornaments and large circular waist shapes. His brass musical horn rests beside him, and several tiny golden meeps accompany his friendly unmistakable silhouette.
art_direction.scene: He sits on a round woven picnic mat and places a little bell beside a plate of simple cakes while three meeps lean curiously toward the food. His horn lies quietly on a folded cloth. A low hill and one broad tree canopy make a peaceful setting, with no lettering or elaborate magical effects.
art_direction.palette: warm russet, pale gold, fluffy ivory, sage
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
